rubrics.justification: The response repeatedly misidentifies the image as an MII oocyte/single cell and does not provide a valid blastocyst morphology assessment of expansion, ICM, or TE.

It barely integrates the patient factors with prognosis; aside from noting low oocyte yield, it does not meaningfully connect age, AMH, BMI, prior cycle, diagnosis, sperm, or endometrium to embryo assessment.
The reasoning is highly repetitive, contradictory, and never resolves the image-text discrepancy into a coherent clinical conclusion.
It does not deliver guideline-consistent embryo assessment or evidence-based transfer recommendations, and it fails to apply Gardner grading appropriately to the case.
No practical transfer recommendations, prognosis range, or future cycle planning steps are provided.
